trades.name: Failed reclaim of 6716-6719
trades.quote: I’ll short a failed reclaim of ES 6716-6719 targeting 6706, today’s low, and lower. Based on today’s profile this would be an A+ setup if trend were bearish. However, since trend is at least neutral here and arguably still constructive on the 30 (and certainly higher frames) I have to downgrade it a to a B+.

trades.quote: I would expect weakness if NQ can’t reclaim the weekly 844-856 spot and would be willing to join a session downtrend targeting 24800 and today’s low. I’ll rate it a B.

trades.name: Hold of 6700-6706

Because of limited range it makes me want to front run a 6706 reclaim which is risky but again, if there is a constructive reversal and solid price action or session information to work with I’ll do so. I’ll rate this a B+
